claims.claim: Original copies, not photocopies or local reprints

No interior page photos provided in photo 0 or photo 1.

claims.claim: 5 copies for 20k & 10 copies for 33k bundle pricing
claims.evidence: Pricing claim cannot be judged from photos; it is a seller statement about a deal structure, not a verifiable physical fact.

risks.risk: Books could be local reprints or pirated copies rather than original publisher editions, which are worth less.
risks.proof: Close-up of the copyright/imprint page, ISBN barcode, and paper/print quality for each title.
risks.if_unproven: priced as local reprints/unofficial copies, not original editions

risks.risk: Pages may contain handwriting, highlighting, or water damage not visible from spine-only shots.
risks.proof: Photos of open interior pages (front, middle, back) for each book.
risks.if_unproven: priced as used copies with writing/damage, not 'like new'

risks.risk: The exact 9 titles shown may not match whichever 5 or 10 are actually bundled per the seller's deal, since the deal implies buyer choice from a larger catalog.
risks.proof: A photo or list confirming which specific titles are included in the 5-copy and 10-copy bundles.
risks.if_unproven: priced only for the titles actually visible in the two photos, not assumed availability of other stock

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the copyright/imprint page and ISBN barcode for each title to confirm original vs. reprint.
Photos of open interior pages (start, middle, end) for each book to confirm no writing/highlighting/damage.
A clear photo or list showing exactly which titles make up the 5-copy and 10-copy bundle offers.
response.reason: The books are individually identifiable by title and author from the spines in both photos, so this is not a cannot_identify case; but authenticity and interior condition are unverifiable remotely, so the lot must be priced at worst case (reprint/pirated, possible writing) until the seller provides interior and imprint-page proof.
